headline: Exelon's Q2 Earnings In Line With Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
summary: EXC's Q2 adjusted earnings rise 10.3% as higher utility rates lifted results, while revenues climb 10% and beat estimates.

headline: IdaCorp (IDA) Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates
summary: IdaCorp (IDA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.29% and -1.80%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
